name: oss-trust
description: Evidence-first open-source dependency due diligence for vulnerabilities, licensing, version drift, deprecation, and maintenance signals.

interface.longDescription: Assess supported open-source dependencies in GitHub repositories or exact npm/PyPI package versions using OSV advisories, package-registry metadata, licensing, deprecation, version information, and upstream maintenance evidence. OSS Trust separates confirmed advisory evidence from ordinary maintenance or version differences and preserves runtime/development scope when the manifest supports it. It is a dependency due-diligence tool, not a generic source-code vulnerability scanner, legal opinion, or security guarantee.
defaultPrompt: Analyze the dependency security posture of npm/cli.
Assess npm lodash version 4.17.20 before adoption.
Check PyPI urllib3 version 1.26.5 for advisories and maintenance signals.

positive.prompt: Analyze the public GitHub repository npm/cli and start with a compact whole-repository dependency and known-advisory summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Inventory supported exact dependencies, perform the repository-level OSV summary, and report affected dependencies and advisory evidence without treating version drift as a vulnerability.

positive.description: Detailed first page of repository dependency evidence
positive.prompt: Analyze the first 20 supported exact dependencies in npm/cli and include OSV plus package-registry metadata where available.
positive.expected_behavior: Analyze repository dependencies from offset 0 with a maximum page size of 20, return pagination metadata, and keep registry/version signals separate from advisories.

positive.prompt: Analyze the next page of supported dependencies in npm/cli starting at dependency offset 20.
positive.expected_behavior: Analyze the repository page starting at offset 20 and return the page's advisory and registry evidence with next-page metadata when more dependencies remain.

positive.prompt: Assess npm package lodash version 4.17.20 for known OSV advisories, declared license, version metadata, deprecation, and upstream maintenance evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Assess exactly lodash 4.17.20, report detailed advisory evidence returned by OSV and registry/upstream metadata, and distinguish confirmed security findings from ordinary maintenance signals.

positive.prompt: Assess PyPI package urllib3 version 1.26.5 for known advisories, declared license, version metadata, and upstream maintenance signals.
positive.expected_behavior: Assess exactly urllib3 1.26.5 using OSV and PyPI metadata, report available evidence, and avoid claiming the package is secure merely because a particular signal is absent.

negative.prompt: Find SQL injection vulnerabilities in the source code of npm/cli.
Upgrade every vulnerable dependency in my GitHub repository and push the changes.
Guarantee that every dependency license in this repository is legally compatible with my product.

review.commerce_description: OSS Trust is read-only and does not sell products, process payments, or modify repositories.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of OSS Trust 0.1.3 with repository-level advisory summaries, exact npm/PyPI package assessment, maintenance and license signals, and GitHub rate-limit fallback behavior.
